local dragToggle = Instance.new("TextButton")
dragToggle.Name = "DragToggle"

dragToggle.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
dragToggle.Parent = screenGui

-- Sürükleyici işlevselliği
local dragStart, dragInput, dragFramePos

local function updateInput(input)
    local delta = input.Position - dragStart
    screenGui.Position = UDim2.new(dragFramePos.X.Scale, delta.X / screenGui.AbsoluteSize.X, dragFramePos.Y.Scale, delta.Y / screenGui.AbsoluteSize.Y)
end

local function onDragStart(input)
    dragStart = input.Position
    dragFramePos = screenGui.Position
    input.Changed:Connect(function()
        if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
            updateInput(input)
        end
    end)
end

dragToggle.InputBegan:Connect(onDragStart)
dragToggle.InputChanged:Connect(updateInput)

scripts.title: Change engine stats
scripts.script:
AB = 2 -- accelerationboost
FU = 0 -- fuelusage
MSB = 10 -- maxspeedboost
TB = 20000 -- torqueboost

for i,v in pairs(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").EngineConfig:GetDescendants()) do
    if v.Name == "AccelerationBoost" then 
        v.Value = AB
    elseif v.Name == "FuelUsage" then 
        v.Value = FU
    elseif v.Name == "MaxSpeedBoost" then 
        v.Value = MSB
    elseif v.Name == "TorqueBoost" then 
        v.Value = TB
    end
end
